output.title: Cannot tell whether HTTP01 Ingress solvers are used
output.content: The release notes say that in v1.18.0, ACME HTTP01 Ingress-based challenges switch to PathType Exact, and they mark this as a breaking change. They also say it is incompatible with certain setups, but the excerpt is cut off before it names them. The environment summary shows only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests and the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD. It shows no Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifests, no ACME HTTP01 solver configuration and no Ingress controller, so we can't tell whether HTTP01 Ingress challenges are used. The values key global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole is set, but its value isn't shown, so it doesn't settle the question. Check whether any Issuer or ClusterIssuer uses an ACME HTTP01 Ingress solver, and if one does, check against the full release notes that your Ingress controller handles PathType Exact.
